normal-100.method: Cold means first Project import into a loaded editor, not browser startup. Each phase ends after text settles, font readiness, image decode and 2 rAF. CPU sampling changes timing; do not compare it as normal latency. CDP durations overlap; GC, hashes, projection and old URL checks are after timing. Projection equality covers cold/reload of the same build only.

cpu-cold.method: Sample-weighted microseconds, including idle/driver work. Inclusive paths overlap; do not sum. Source positions are function starts, not individual hot statements. Sampling is not exact function timing.

cpu-reload.method: Sample-weighted microseconds, including idle/driver work. Inclusive paths overlap; do not sum. Source positions are function starts, not individual hot statements. Sampling is not exact function timing.

limitations: One cold/reload observation per run, 1000-label repeated once. Not a statistical benchmark or A/B/B/A comparison.
Application unchanged; label/direct variants change only measurement queries. No speed improvement established.
Raw profiles and build artifacts remain in /tmp; repository keeps report values, mapped summaries and hashes. Rebuild and rerun to regenerate profiles.
A first localhost/127.0.0.1 mismatch refused connection before import and produced no report; rerun used localhost.
Short formatter/syntax-check work ran while direct CPU capture was active. CPU timings are diagnostic only and not compared as latency; no build or application tests ran during capture.
